notes: Tail case, all units rewritten. U1 lamp is the tall lantern streetlight at the right above the white fence (ref said left) and already black -> dark green. U2 is the white information board right of the gate (ref said left); colour-only replace -> wooden notice board. U3 removed a worn coat -> now removes the whole woman in the mauve hooded coat (SAM3 v2 person mask). U4 window ref was 'right' but it is left of center -> anchored to the woman taking a photo; payload made specific.
